subject: Recap + ask: budget anchor, token profile, and founders program request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@clipperlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: budget anchor, token profile, and founders program request

Hi Nina —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap and three asks so we can put a concrete proposal in front of your CFO: 

1) Token profile (what you said on the call):
- Expected steady-state: ~40M tokens / month after pilot (Q3).
- Pilot: 6–8M tokens / month for 8 weeks.
- Typical call/session: 850 tokens input + 1,200 tokens generated (avg ~2,050 tokens per request).

2) Budget anchor and target unit economics:
- You mentioned a target of ~$18 per 1M tokens for long-term budgeting.
- For the pilot, you asked for a price that keeps runway predictable (target ~$30 / 1M tokens or lower for the 8-week window).

3) Discount ask & program fit:
- You asked whether Clippert Labs would qualify for our Founders / Startup track and what committed-use tiers look like (12 vs 24 month).

Asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether the 40M/month is net of embeddings/other non-chat traffic?
- CFO contact for procurement questions (we can draft a shortened SOW + payment schedule).
- Any hard constraints on start date for a reserved plan (you said mid-August but wanted to confirm).

What we can move forward with now (internal note included in the attached cost sheet):
- Pilot pricing (8 weeks): $28 / 1M tokens, capped usage option for predictability.
- If Clippert signs a 12-month committed-use agreement with a 40M/mo baseline, we can reach ~$16 / 1M tokens effective rate with a phased tier (higher during months 1–2 while usage ramps).
- Founders program: for qualifying early-stage customers we can add a one-time credit (equivalent to 100k tokens) plus a 10% uplift on the committed discount for the first year; we need your company stage and cap table details to confirm eligibility.

Next steps I propose:
- Nina: confirm the quick clarifications above and whether we should include finance@clipperlabs on the next thread.
- Ben/Marissa: I'll expect you to review the attached cost sheet and a starter term we discussed; Ben to propose the simplest committed-use blurb we can ship for procurement.

I'll follow up with a short, redlined starter term and a simple one-page MAA for your legal if you want to move to procurement.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Nina Patel <nina@clipperlabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clippert Labs Finance <finance@clipperlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: budget anchor, token profile, and founders program request

Hi Sean — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Quick answers below: 

- The 40M / month is our expected *inference token* volume only (chat+generation). Embeddings and vector index refreshes are a separate budget line and look like ~3–4M tokens / month.
- CFO is Priya Menon (priya.menon@clipperlabs.com); she asked for a simple pilot cost + an optional committed-use quote to review.
- Start date for reserved capacity: aiming for Aug 15 (can move up a week if we sign before July).

A few constraints from finance/legal:
- They prefer a cancellable pilot with an option to convert credits to committed-use on signature (no multi-month prepayment for the pilot).
- Discount decisions require a short deck that shows unit economics and committed breakpoints (i.e., what 12 vs 24 months looks like at 40M baseline).

Founders program: we are a seed-stage company with <$5M raised (cap table is simple). Priya said she is happy to provide a one-page summary of funding if that helps qualify.

Attaching our internal usage snapshot (low-res): call logs and session size histogram. Let me know if you want more detail.

—Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Product
Clipper Labs

Attachment: clipper-usage-snapshot-may12.csv (attached)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@clipperlabs.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Clippert Labs Finance <finance@clipperlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: budget anchor, token profile, and founders program request

Hi Nina — looping in a short, operational proposal and an attached cost sheet. Key points: 

1) Pilot (no prepay, cancellable):
- 8 week pilot window; $28 / 1M tokens applied to bill (no upfront payment).
- If you convert to committed-use within 30 days after pilot, 50% of pilot invoice applied as a credit to the committed contract (this preserves your runway concern).

2) Committed-use options (baseline: 40M tokens / month):
- 12 month firm baseline: effective $16 / 1M tokens; 10% overage charge above baseline at the $16 rate (we invoice overage monthly).
- 24 month firm baseline: effective $13.75 / 1M tokens + 3% annual price protection built into the term.
- Both options include access to Redwood Optimize recommendations (auto-batching suggestions) and a quarterly quality/regression eval.

3) Founders / Startup add-on: (subject to qualification)
- One-time credit equal to $3k (applied over first two billing cycles) + an additional 5% off effective committed rate for 12 months.
- For seed-stage with <$5M raised, we can fast-track the credit with a brief funding summary.

Attachments in this email: RDW-Clipper-Cost-Sheet-May12.xlsx (contains a month-by-month pro forma and sensitivity table).

If that looks reasonable, we can:
- Draft a 1-page MAA (minimal terms) and a simple purchase order template for Priya to speed procurement.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement call next Wed (May 19) or Thu (May 20) to walk the CFO through the conversion and invoicing mechanics.

Let me know which date works — I can carve Ben/billing time or Marissa for technical/ops questions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales - Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@clipperlabs.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clipperlabs.com>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: budget anchor, and founders program request — proposed next steps

Hi Nina / Priya — quick logistics note from Ops:

- Proposed procurement touchpoint: Thu, 20 May 2027, 10:00am PT — 30 minutes to review the pilot billing approach and conversion credit. If that doesn't work, Marissa/Ben available May 21 afternoon.
- Nina: please send the one-page funding summary when convenient so Ben can fast-track the founders credit.
- Priya: we'll prepare the 1-page MAA and the PO template in advance of the call. We'll also include the RDW cost sheet as an attachment to the PO email.

I'll leave scheduling to Priya / Nina; Ben and I will join the call and have billing and technical ops ready to answer questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
